name: Capps Residence

nadir.desc: The property has a single-story residence with a light brown shingle roof and light exterior walls|A detached garage with a matching roof sits near the house across a dirt driveway|A small shed stands farther back in the yard|The lot is mostly dirt and gravel with scattered evergreen trees and a small lawn patch to the right and in front of the residence|A dirt or gravel semi-circular driveway sits between the residence and street|A chain-linked fence is visible along the right of the house and a wooden fence along the left side.

alpha.desc: The house faces 73rd St across a small lawn enclosed by a low fence|The light-colored exterior walls and brown multi-gabled roof are visible from the road|A dirt and gravel driveway runs in front of the residence and detached garage|A parked truck, RV and boat sits along side the garage|A low stone or rock wall runs along part of the road frontage|Trees stand near the house and garage.

bravo.desc: The left side of the lot shows a deck and outdoor storage between the residence and the fence|An enclosure sits directly behind the residence against the fence|Grass in the front yard and dirt in the backyard with evergreen trees fill the side yard|The road frontage remains visible past the front of the house.

charlie.desc: The rear of the lot shows open dirt yard behind the house and garage, with a small shed and additional storage near the back|A chain linked fence runs along parts of the rear and side lines|Evergreen trees are scattered through the yard|Sheds, parked vehicles and outdoor equipment are found around the back yard|Access through the lot remains via the dirt driveway between the house and garage.

delta.desc: The left side of the property shows the outer yard beyond the house, with dirt, trees, and a chain linked fence run along the outer edge|Stored materials, vehicles and outdoor equipment occupy portions of this side yard|The detached garage and shed remain visible toward the center of the lot|The dirt driveway continues to provide circulation between the structures and the road.

considerations: Vehicle access is from 73rd St onto a dirt and gravel semi-circular driveway that leads between the house and the detached garage. A dirt path runs to the back yard with parked vehicles, trailers, and stored materials in several places. A low wall and fence segments define parts of the road frontage and outer lines. No clear gate location is visible from the imagery. Side and rear yard access appears open along the dirt surfaces inside the fence line.
clarifications: Is the detached building a garage only, or does it include living space? Are there any side gates, and do they lock? Is there rear vehicle access beyond the dirt driveway between the house and garage? Are any portions of the wire fencing gated? What is the circular structure in the open yard?
